correctness.rationale: Ultrahomogeneity identifies injective tuple orbits with labeled members of the age. The age consists of a poset plus a distinguished linear extension, so double counting gives both n! times A006455 and the sum of all linear-extension counts. Equality partitions yield the Stirling transform; small cases were independently brute-forced.
